Control Vulnerability Description: Classification markings are not carried on every output: TAK/CoT events, the CSV track export, the audit CSV, registry sheets and configuration exports carry no marking, and the UI does not show a track's own label.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Mark each output (CoT detail element, export headers) and show the track label in the UI; or refuse labelled tracks on unmarked outputs. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Mark each output (CoT detail element, export headers) and show the track label in the UI; or refuse labelled tracks on unmarked outputs.

Control Vulnerability Description: Listening sources can accept unauthenticated devices: UDP and multicast, TCP server without client_ca_file, gRPC server without a bearer token.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Require mTLS or a token on listening sources unless explicitly allowed, and list the exception in the hardening checklist. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Require mTLS or a token on listening sources unless explicitly allowed, and list the exception in the hardening checklist.

Control Vulnerability Description: Release images are signed with cosign's standard (non-FIPS) cryptography and a file key.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Sign with a FIPS-validated module (Go FIPS mode or a KMS/HSM key). [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Sign with a FIPS-validated module (Go FIPS mode or a KMS/HSM key).

Control Vulnerability Description: The user interface and the administration functions share one listener and sign-in; only role checks separate them.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Add an optional admin-only listener (e.g. OT_ADMIN_BIND) so a site can put administration on a management network. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Add an optional admin-only listener (e.g. OT_ADMIN_BIND) so a site can put administration on a management network.

Control Vulnerability Description: Multicast (UDP sources and TAK SA output) is IPv4 only.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Add IPv6 multicast and IPv6 tests. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Add IPv6 multicast and IPv6 tests.

Control Vulnerability Description: The sample docker-compose.yml uses host networking, a bind mount, and no CPU, memory or process limits.
Milestone with Completion Dates: Next 0.4 release: Ship a bridge network with only 8090 published, a named volume and resource limits; document host networking as an exception. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Ship a bridge network with only 8090 published, a named volume and resource limits; document host networking as an exception.

Control Vulnerability Description: The v0.4.2 and v0.4.3 images have 5 Critical, 61 High, 99 Medium and 90 Low findings, all in Debian 12 base packages (perl-base, util-linux, libxml2, zlib, ncurses, ...), none with a fix at scan time (tzdata has one).
Milestone with Completion Dates: Next 0.4 release: Rebuild on the current base; move to a minimal runtime image carrying only what the binary, SAML (libxml2/xmlsec) and the OpenSSL FIPS provider need. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Rebuild on the current base; move to a minimal runtime image carrying only what the binary, SAML (libxml2/xmlsec) and the OpenSSL FIPS provider need.

Control Vulnerability Description: Dependency advisories and the image scan run only on push or release, not on a schedule.
Milestone with Completion Dates: Risk accepted: Accepted by the product owner (2026-09-30): dependency advisories and the image scan run when each release is built (scripts/ato/scan, cargo deny, npm audit), not on a schedule. A site that needs scheduled scanning runs scripts/ato/scan on its own schedule. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Accepted by the product owner (2026-09-30): dependency advisories and the image scan run when each release is built (scripts/ato/scan, cargo deny, npm audit), not on a schedule. A site that needs scheduled scanning runs scripts/ato/scan on its own schedule.

Control Vulnerability Description: The Content Security Policy allows inline styles (style-src 'unsafe-inline'), which React, MapLibre and CodeMirror need (finding F-5).
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: Move inline styles to classes or nonces where the libraries allow; accept the residual risk otherwise. [[DATE]]
Recommendations: Move inline styles to classes or nonces where the libraries allow; accept the residual risk otherwise.

Control Vulnerability Description: Client-certificate revocation is checked with CRLs only (end-entity), not OCSP.
Milestone with Completion Dates: 0.5.0: OCSP with stapling or responder queries (#21). [[DATE]]
Recommendations: OCSP with stapling or responder queries (#21).
